name: AgenticOS
description: Connect this Mattermost server to your own AgenticOS instance.

settings_schema.header: Connect directly to your own AgenticOS instance. No AgenticOS Bridge account is required. After saving, run /agenticos connect in the target team channel.

settings.help_text: HTTPS origin, for example https://agents.example.com. No path, query or credentials.
Organization UUID from AgenticOS. Setup credentials must belong to a member with channels:manage.
UUID of the agent to expose. Publish the agent first; setup also requires permission to publish it. Disconnect before changing the target.
